why: A shared Alt-ID Kind+Value counts as a MATCH only when the relation is absent, empty or IsSameAs. IsDerivedFrom, IsPartOf and Deprecated all assert that the identifier names a DIFFERENT work, so counting them as identity evidence inverts their meaning. Before eidr-core 0.22.0 the relation clause was consulted only in the conflict branch, so these scored a full alt-id match; across four labelled corpora that affected 58 of 62,646 shared pairs and could lift a pair into Accept via ALT_CORROBORATION_STRONG_MIN. The entry is filtered before the match/conflict branch, so it is evidence of NOTHING in either direction -- a Deprecated id that differs is not evidence the works differ either. Same creation type here, so no gate is involved: this pins the comparator, not a guard.
